files.description: Loyalty memberships (200 rows): member_ref (six-digit reference with leading zeros), plan (bronze, silver, gold or platinum), city (city name; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent in some rows), points (whole number, multiples of 50; many members share the same points).

task_text: For each plan, count how many members have each points value, and keep only the three lowest points values of each plan. `result` should be a Series of counts indexed by plan and points, with the plans in alphabetical order and the points from lowest to highest within each plan.
intended_computation: Within each of the 4 plans, count members per distinct points value, take the three smallest points values of that plan with their counts (12 rows in all), ordered by plan ascending then points ascending.

predicted_direction.reason: groupby(...).value_counts(sort=False) listed points in sorted order within each plan on 2.x, so head(3) per plan gave the lowest values; on 3.x it lists them in order of appearance.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R02; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
